name: AgentMod
creator: @FloWritesCode
ai_quote: So I (Cursor) built a Minecraft Mod that shows all ongoing + recently finished Cursors & Codex agents.
summary: Keep an eye on your Cursor and Codex coding agents without leaving Minecraft.
changes: Adds an in-game agent sidebar, conversation window and notifications. Read ongoing work, reply to agents, and start a new coding task while staying in your Minecraft world. This is a developer utility inside the game rather than a new game mode.
install: The creator lists Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API for Minecraft 26.3. Place the AgentMod and Fabric API JARs in your Minecraft mods folder, then launch the Fabric profile. Optional desktop bridge setup is needed for Cursor replies. Installation has not been attempted.

name: PTC Trainer
creator: @ppittocco
ai_quote: made a mod menu for GTA V in the browser with Claude
ai_note: AI-build attribution reported from the original X post; not stated in the repository README.
summary: An F8 trainer menu for a GTA V WebAssembly browser port, with vehicle spawns and world controls.
changes: Adds an in-game trainer for god mode, spawning vehicles, teleports and weather controls. The project patches the browser port’s WebAssembly code and runs through its shared-memory native interface. Compatibility is specific to the port; this is not a mod for ordinary GTA V installation.
install: The project provides an installer that patches files in a browser-port distribution. Do not run it based on this listing. Read the official repository for its prerequisites and compatibility notes.
working_evidence: Creator demonstration and code are available. No independent working report or positive comments were confirmed during research.
security: Codex Security reviewed six installer and browser-menu source files. No confirmed vulnerability found in those files. Game files, dependencies and release artifacts remain unverified.

name: Saints Row: The Third RTX Remix Compatibility Mod
creator: @Freedom_Trinity
ai_quote: this is created with Claude opus and some fable 5 through visual studio code.
summary: A compatibility shim to help RTX Remix path-trace the original 2011 game.
changes: Converts shader-driven rendering to a fixed-function form that RTX Remix can capture and recovers camera information for lighting. This targets the original DirectX 9 release, not the remastered edition. The creator describes ongoing problems with sky and HUD rendering.
install: Use the creator’s exact game-version and RTX Remix setup instructions. The project includes native code and an installer workflow; neither has been executed during research.
working_evidence: Creator work-in-progress statement and source are available. Independent working reports and community praise were not verified.
security: Partial Codex Security source review found one low-severity issue: crafted shader metadata can read outside its buffer and potentially crash the game. Runtime reproduction and release-binary certification were not performed.

summary: Explore Outlast 2 with a single-player menu for noclip, teleportation, god mode and spawns.
security: Not scanned during this review. Source or distributed-file review is required before installing; no safety claim is made.
